targets.title: Explaining the impact of scarcity appeals in advertising: The mediating role of perceptions of susceptibility
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper, we describe our efforts to replicate and extend Eisend’s (2008) research on the mediating role of FPE in the impact of scarcity appeals in advertising on consumers’ purchase intentions.
targets.outcome_quote: In this study we could not replicate Eisend’s (2008) findings but we found full support for our revised model.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict says the original findings could not be replicated. The supported alternative model is an extension and does not change that verdict.

reasoning: New undergraduate sample tests the original model using changed product and scarcity manipulation. Complete author manuscript includes references and tables; identity and authors confirmed by publisher and institutional landing records.
